purpose: Did we break what already worked? Frozen per-task input/output snapshots that guard against silent prompt drift. Spec: docs/validation.md §4.

policy.acceptingAMismatch: Requires `npm run eval -- --set=regression --accept=<caseId>`, which rewrites the snapshot, updates acceptedAt and acceptedBy, and MUST appear in the commit diff. A snapshot never updates implicitly.
policy.reviewRule: Never accept a regression snapshot change without reading the diff and stating in the commit message why the new output is correct.
whyThisExists: Prompts, provider versions and model ids all drift silently.
Without snapshots, quality degrades gradually and nobody notices until the demo.
The guard is deliberately annoying. That is the point.
neverAcceptWhen: A forbidden phrase from docs/validation.md §6 appears in the new output.
Confidence increased without a corresponding input change.
Risks or frictions decreased on a deliberately weak input.
Any numeric value in the output changed (numbers must not originate from a model).

cases.note: Populated the first time task 004 runs with --accept. Reference fixture — this snapshot is what makes the demo reproducible across prompt edits.
